title: Professional Services Financial Planning Platforms Worth Comparing in 2026: A Side-by-Side Scorecard
summary: A scorecard for comparing financial planning platforms for professional services firms, covering Abacum, Pigment, Anaplan, Workday, Planful, Cube, Jirav and Mosaic.
body_markdown:
For a professional services firm, the platforms worth comparing are the ones that plan the firm the way you bill it. Abacum is the AI-native business planning platform for scaling enterprises. It brings all your data, business logic and business context into one governed place. This page gives you a scorecard you can use in every demo, then compares Abacum, Pigment, Anaplan, Workday Adaptive Planning, Planful, Cube, Jirav and Mosaic.


## The scorecard


Score each platform from 0 (not shown) to 2 (shown live with your scenario). The maximum is 16.

Pigment is a flexible modeling platform for teams willing to build and maintain their own planning models. Your team or an implementation partner designs it and keeps it running, so confirm who will own the model after go-live.


## Why these criteria


Billable utilization fell to 66.4% in 2025, the lowest on record (SPI via Rocketlane, 2025). A platform that recalculates margin and hiring needs when utilization moves is worth more than one that reports it after quarter-end.


## What you will see from Abacum


-


**Plan the firm like you bill it.** Revenue from headcount, utilization and rate.


-


**Margin fade, early.** Practice and client P&L with weekly rolling forecasts.


-


**Capacity tied to hiring.** Hiring keeps pace with the work you've sold.


-


**Above the ERP.** We replace the spreadsheet, not the system of record.


-


**AI Modeler.** Describe the model you need in plain language, or bring the spreadsheet you already built, and get a working model in minutes. Every model explains itself, line by line. The agent proposes, the engine calculates and you approve. Nothing saves until you approve.


-


**Included, not metered.** Standard functionality with no credits and no hidden fees.


Abacum holds a 4.7 rating on G2 (as of October 2026). Implementation runs six to nine weeks depending on data complexity, entity count and workflows.
